label: late original-phase input, boosted by b/f inputs or x/m/t-initial sequences
explanation: Fires only during the original (input) phase, from step 3 onward (peak at t=4-6, nothing at t<=2 or t>=9), never on <DEL> or in the copy phase. Within that window, two additive factors raise the rate: the current input is b or f (about 9x lift each, together about 65% of activation mass), and the sequence begins with x, m or t (about 5x lift each). It is also more likely on the first occurrence of a token. The top activations combine these: b/f input at t=4-6 in a sequence starting with x/m/t. Their conjunction has precision 0.82 but recall only 0.14. The union predicate covers about 94% of activation mass but has low precision (~0.21), because most b/f steps and most x/m/t-initial steps never cross the threshold. The unit looks like a graded, distributed sum of position, current token and first token rather than a crisp detector.
